infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Wardrobe uses your camera to photograph clothing items so they can be catalogued and AI-tagged in your digital wardrobe.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Wardrobe accesses your photo library so you can pick existing photos of clothing items to add to your wardrobe.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Wardrobe may save processed clothing images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is not used by Wardrobe but is required by the camera framework.

plugins.photosPermission: Wardrobe accesses your photos to add clothing items to your wardrobe.
plugins.cameraPermission: Wardrobe uses the camera to photograph your clothing items.
